student.scope_note: The original update field applies to A. B adds the listed kernel coordinates to the same single Adam call.

evaluation.kernel_audit: source weight immutable; DC/detail deltas; Q orthogonality; relevant cosine Gram; actual effective-kernel displacement; gains; same current q evaluation
evaluation.memory_metrics_for_no_RP: NOT_APPLICABLE, not zero or fabricated pseudo-memory
evaluation.graph_auxiliary: For G arms evaluate unmodified q and qstar after commit, valid counts for correction transitions, band fractions, and confidence anchors; dense tensors released after evaluator.
evaluation.graph_not_RP: No shadow banks for graph arms; memory quality NOT_APPLICABLE.

selection.graph_qualification: Net student gain over C and direct controls, plus localized teacher correction evidence; no promotion from geometry/auxiliary metrics alone.

supersedes: Unexecuted R4/R4D scheduling only. Prior ten arm definitions and shared scientific settings unchanged. Do not execute old and new queues cumulatively.

kernel_geometry.status: new experimental design; not original PAID and not a proven anti-forgetting method
kernel_geometry.source_assets: given checkpoint tensors only; PAID source statistics and source subset are NOT used
kernel_geometry.K_ALL: same Q and gains on ALL spatial kernel offsets; no detail protection
kernel_geometry.K_MAG: KDG with Q=I; only train output log gains
kernel_geometry.K_FREE: W_eff=W0+(row_norm(A0)/sqrt(Cin)*E)*b; unconstrained E; no separate gains
kernel_geometry.Q: solve(I+0.5*S,I-0.5*S), S skew from independent strict-upper-triangular coordinates
kernel_geometry.zero_initialization: all added coordinates exactly zero; no Python zero-state branch that disconnects derivatives
kernel_geometry.matrix_dtype: float64 on model device; cast effective kernel to model float32 with autograd retained
kernel_geometry.optimizer: one Adam call on original BN affine plus new coordinates; all lr=1e-4 betas=(0.9,0.999) eps=1e-8 wd=0
kernel_geometry.source_weight_storage: original frozen weight/bias tensors immutable; effective kernels created differentiably per forward
kernel_geometry.gain_parameterization: exp(a); strictly positive, no unreported clamp or bound
kernel_geometry.source_zero_DC_row_policy: zero DC rows remain zero; no artificial source direction or minimum norm invented
kernel_geometry.scope_of_guarantee: local algebraic kernel decomposition only; not exact output/boundary/topology/source-accuracy preservation
kernel_geometry.control_caveat: KDG and K_ALL match coordinates; K_MAG and K_FREE deliberately do not match parameter counts or effective step sizes

boundary_graph.parent_R3_family: 5: G spatial graph teacher, not U and not a new sixth research family
boundary_graph.claim_scope: New project graph-teacher redesign. Not full SPEGC; not a new invention of harmonic/seeded graph segmentation; no correctness or anti-forgetting guarantee.
boundary_graph.inputs: current already-resized raw RGB [0,1], current student original six aligned probability maps and mean q, global visit for local shuffle seed only
boundary_graph.model_norm: original C current input statistics unchanged
boundary_graph.reduce: 4x4 average pooling of probabilities and raw RGB from 512 grid; do not pool logits or use RP grid indices
boundary_graph.edges: undirected 4-neighbour; horizontal then vertical; no self loops, no wrap-around, no fabricated image-border edges
boundary_graph.reliable: (q<=0.1 or q>=0.9) AND all six hard probabilities agree with q>=0.5; computed separately at coarse and full grid
boundary_graph.contour: both endpoints of four-neighbour changes of q>=0.5, separately per independent OD/OC channel
boundary_graph.anchor_values: original soft q for ALL fixed nodes; never round seeds to 0/1; no external scribbles
boundary_graph.rgb_standardization: per current image/channel coarse-grid mean and population std; denominator max(std,0.05); graph-only, never replaces model preprocessing
boundary_graph.CONST: each horizontal weight replaced by horizontal mean; same for vertical; matches orientation-specific weight sum, not nodewise degrees
boundary_graph.SHUFFLE: independent orientation-wise permutations of original edge-weight lists, preserving counts and multisets; endpoint topology and free mask unchanged
boundary_graph.shuffle_seed: first 8 big-endian bytes SHA256(R4T_G|20260907|visit|h_or_v) modulo (2^63-1); local CPU generator only
boundary_graph.solver: 64 synchronous Jacobi iterations starting at q; full positive fidelity for every free node; no early stopping gate
boundary_graph.solver_scope: strictly convex anchored probability graph; NOT exact clinical segmentation. No dense 16384^2 allocation.
boundary_graph.lift: bilinear probability residual Q-q to full grid (align_corners=False); mask by nearest free-grid lift AND NOT full-grid reliable; clamp q+residual to [0,1] INSIDE support only; outside copy original q bitwise
boundary_graph.BCE: same full-image ordinary BCEWithLogits as C; no region reweighting and no extra graph loss
boundary_graph.final_output: raw student original prediction after one Adam, never refined q
boundary_graph.no_boundary_or_no_free_nodes: exact original q, still normal C update; not a skip/reset/failure
boundary_graph.aux_evaluation: q and qstar Dice/Brier plus correct-to-wrong and wrong-to-correct teacher pixel counts after all model state commit; no metric feedback
risks: RGB boundaries can be vessels or illumination rather than OD/OC
missed confident structures cannot be invented
restricted teacher changes do not restrict student output changes outside the band
controls match rules, not identical masks after trajectories diverge

directions.A: teacher timescale x regional PCA (six original arms)
directions.B: KDG and controls (four original arms; thematic continuation of R3 U)
directions.C: boundary-anchored graph supervision (four new arms; direct redesign of R3 G)
